name: Orgel ~Kesenai Melody~
original_name: オルゴール～消せないメロディー～
source:
This is a collection of four short stories:

1. Tokyo Lover『東京恋人』is a story of an innocent girl Yuka, a free-spirited girl Kanoka, and the hero.
2. Water Balloon『水風船』is a story of pure love with a girl who is 5 years younger than the hero.
3. Square Sky『四角い空』is a story about Stockholm syndrome of a girl confined in a warehouse towards her offender.
4. Once the three stories above are all completed, the last story Reality『現実』is unlocked.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
